title: PR #200: [Draft] Catalog logic hardening: architecture layers and source accounting
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Purpose

Professionally harden the canonical component/function catalog against architecture drift and stale metadata. This is a Draft PR; it does not claim source completeness or functional verification.

## Changes
- Reconcile 31 component primary-layer mappings against `ARCHITECTURE.md` L0-L7 + X.
- Add `architectural_layers` so cross-domain components such as ATC Node can express L0 + L2 without inventing a new layer taxonomy.
- Add explicit architecture binding metadata to the catalog.
- Derive source-binding accounting for all 104 function records: binding objects, source paths, exact source SHAs, and status breakdown.
- Explicitly classify `COMP-DEMO` as excluded from production-readiness interpretation; it remains a fixture and must not enter the live drift gate.
- Extend the existing taxonomy validator and regression tests to fail closed on layer drift, stale source counters, invalid multi-layer mappings, and missing demo-fixture exclusion.
- Update the human-readable catalog and run the existing workflow when `ARCHITECTURE.md` changes.

## Guardrails
- No second catalog or repository manifest is created.
- No implementation is marked VERIFIED; catalog release decision remains BLOCKED.
- No merge, auto-merge, gate weakening, or production-readiness assertion.

## Required validation
- `python3 tools/validate_catalog_taxonomy.py`
- `python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_validate_catalog_taxonomy -v`
- Existing component/function specification validator and exact-HEAD workflow evidence.
- Review the layer mapping against architecture owner decisions before merge.
